title: Jazzy Greek Rice Risotto
description: A pungent, creamy lazy-sunday Mediterranean dish featuring raisins, nuka-pickle and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly flavors.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in white wine, stir, and let it reduce by half, about 3 minutes.
Add Arborio rice, stirring constantly for 2 minutes to toast the grains.
Begin ladling warm vegetable broth one cup at a time, stirring frequently, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding the next.
When the rice is al dente and creamy, fold in raisins, nuka-pickle slices, and lemon zest.
Reduce heat to low, add crumbled feta cheese and chopped dill, stirring until cheese melts.
Season with salt, taste, and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with extra dill or lemon zest.
